# Cloudflare Kumo provenance

`read_when`: changing Kumo-derived component metadata, styling definitions, or third-party notices

Phi is an independent Vue project, not a fork of Kumo. Portions of its variant metadata and styling definitions
were adapted from Cloudflare Kumo and are used under Kumo's MIT license.

- upstream: <https://github.com/cloudflare/kumo>
- audited revision: `ff76f302aa0144b006a136c0d652f0693f15ee80`
- license: [LICENSE](./LICENSE)

Keep the license text verbatim. The package notice generator combines it with licenses discovered from the actual
dependencies bundled into `packages/phi/dist`.
